import Prelude
def one : Nat := 1
def two : Nat := one
note: Both servers count positions in UTF-16 code units and take whole-document didChange (textDocumentSync 1, full). The corpus applies a range edit client-side and sends the whole text, so a move to incremental sync (2) must fail here, not silently mis-drive the session.
